country.evidence_quote: The PIONEER Alliance Governance Week brought together Governing Board, Steering Committee members, coordinators, and work package leaders from ten European higher education institutions at Laurea University of Applied Sciences’ Leppävaara Campus in Espoo, Finland. As the Alliance Chair institution for 2026, Laurea hosted the event, which focused on the strategic development of the alliance, future priorities, and ways to strengthen the impact of European higher education cooperation.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Laurea, Metropolia and Haaga-Helia have actively collaborated in the framework of 3UAS and Green Exchange. In 2022 we started the Green Exchange Ambassador program where students from these UAS are posting their experiences and thoughts regarding greener choices before, during and after their exchanges around the world.
